statement: The Linux wireless xpad FF_RUMBLE path constructs a 12-byte wireless command, distinct from the wired Xbox 360 8-byte rumble, and LED uses the wireless output format. Each USB interface context has its own interrupt OUT URB and queue, giving slot-directed routing through the interface rather than through a global player index. Absent slots have no registered evdev/LED callbacks.
